headline: ChatGPT desktop app routes to Bedrock in GovCloud
lede: A security team can run the ChatGPT desktop app with inference routed to Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US-West) using API-mode sign-in and managed policies.

with.title: Phonon-2 speech recognition fits in 164MB on CPU

possibilities.connection: Phonon-2 transcribes English on any CPU in a 164MB model, so audio never leaves the laptop, while the ChatGPT desktop app routed to Bedrock in GovCloud handles the drafting step on an approved cloud boundary.
